name: Karlsruhe Baden-Baden Airport
before:
Baden-Wurttemberg's second airport after Stuttgart, and twelfth in Germany, with just under 2.26 million passengers in 2025. It is mostly low cost and leisure flying rather than scheduled business traffic.

The name covers two towns and the airport sits between them without being in either. It is in Rheinmunster, 40 km south of Karlsruhe and 12 km west of Baden-Baden, and is also within reach of Strasbourg 25 km to the south. For a client heading to the spa town, this is much closer than any of the larger German airports.

The terminal is small and honest about it: 20 check in counters, eight departure gates, a few shops and places to eat. There are no air bridges, so boarding is on foot or by bus from eight aircraft stands built for mid sized jets.

The airport forms part of the Baden Airpark business park and is often used by airlines for crew training flights.
